newest.title: Is OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra worth the cost for your business or research?
newest.description: Is OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra worth the cost for your business or research?. Whether the high cost and performance benchmarks of GPT-6 Astra represent a necessary leap in utility or an expensive barrier to entry for smaller organizations. What we covered: • OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, its new flagship model • Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent that can take actions in other apps • Meta says Muse is built with a dedicated secure virtual machine for user data and agent actions • Australian government proposes social-media algorithm opt-outs and AI chatbot child-safety rules • Meta launches Muse personal AI agent that can send emails, book travel, and make purchases One lead story. The other headlines are supporting evidence, complications, or counterexamples. Listener question: Does the performance of GPT-6 Astra justify its $50/million output token price tag compared to current alternatives? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
